May 26, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Evanson Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Wal (WMT) by 114.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evanson Asset Management Llc bought 3,297 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,186 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $611,000, up from 2,889 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evanson Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Wal for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $243.46 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $0.39 during the last trading session, reaching $82.46. About 5.91 million shares traded. Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 23.53% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.98% the S&P500.
